# Dorian Award for Outstanding Broadway Musical Revival

}}
The Dorian Award for Outstanding Broadway Musical Revival is one of the main categories of Dorian Theatre Awards, given annually to the best revival of a musical on Broadway by GALECA: The Society of LGBTQ Entertainment Critics since 2010 (the group was initially named the Gay and Lesbian Entertainment Critics Association). The category was introduced in 2023 when the awards began honoring Broadway theatre.
